stream.media_panel_text:
Connect your Twitch channel. Every stream is then announced here automatically – with live role and clips.

**How it works (1 minute):**
**1.** Click **Connect Twitch** below
**2.** Enter your Twitch name
**3.** Type the code you get into **your own** Twitch chat

Done. You don't need to be live.

start.title: 👋 Getting started
start.text:
On this server you collect **XP** and **{currency}**, level up, found **gangs** and get rewarded during streams.

**Key commands**
`/level` – your level & rank
`/daily` – daily reward
`/profile` – your profile
`/quests` – tasks with rewards
`/gang` – found or join a crew
`/streams` – who's live?

Pick a topic below for details.

xp.title: ⭐ XP & levels
xp.text:
**XP are experience points.** The more you take part, the more you get – and the higher your level.

**How to earn XP**
💬 Message: **{xp_min}–{xp_max} XP** (at most every {cooldown} seconds – spamming doesn't help)
🎙️ Voice: **{voice_xp} XP per minute** (only with others, not muted)
😀 Reaction: **{reaction_xp} XP**
📺 "I'm watching" during a stream: **{stream_xp} XP**

**How much do I need?**
Level 5 → {lvl5} XP · Level 10 → {lvl10} XP
Level 25 → {lvl25} XP · Level 50 → {lvl50} XP

Certain levels unlock **roles** automatically. Check with `/level`, ranking with `/leaderboard`.

coins.title: 💰 Coins & shop
coins.text:
**{currency}** are the server currency (not real money).

**Earn**
💬 Messages: {msg_min}–{msg_max} each
📅 `/daily`: {daily} (+ streak bonus, 7 days: +{streak7}, 30 days: +{streak30})
🗓️ `/weekly`: {weekly}
💼 `/work` · 🦹 `/crime` · 🥷 `/rob` (risky!)
🎰 `/slots` · 🪙 `/bet` – gamble with coins

**Spend**
`/shop` – buy roles, colors, badges
`/pay` – send coins
`/gang deposit` – fill the gang bank

gangs.title: 🏴 Gangs
gangs.text:
Found a **gang** with your people and fight for #1.

`/gang create` – found your gang (costs {gang_cost})
`/gang invite @user` – invite people (max {gang_max})
`/gang deposit` – coins into the gang bank
`/gang info` – view your crew
`/gang top` – ranking

**Gang power** = XP of all members + gang bank. The more active your crew, the higher you rise.

streams.title: 📡 Streams
streams.text:
As soon as the stream starts, the bot posts in the alert channel.

**Being there pays off:** click **"I'm watching"** in the live post to get XP and {currency}.
Regulars automatically become **Stammzuschauer**, then **Day One**, then **OG Viewer**.

`/streams` – who's live
`/schedule` – next stream
`/streamtop` – most loyal viewers
New clips land in the clip channel automatically.

tickets.title: 🎫 Support & tickets
tickets.text:
Need help or want to report something?

1. Go to **#tickets**
2. Pick a category (support, application, complaint …)
3. Briefly describe your issue

A private channel opens just for you and the team.

More help:
`/suggest` – submit an idea
Right-click a message → **Apps → Nachricht melden**
